metadata.title: Sentinel-IPAbuse-TriageAndBlock
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel playbook that, on each incident, autonomously raises an OPSLSY Technical change (clone of OPSLSY-75376), walks it to Implementation, enriches the incident IPs against AbuseIPDB, appends the kept IPs to a static-site blocklist blob, attaches the CSV report to the change, then walks the change to Closed with resolution Successful. No human approval and no CLOPSSEC ticket. If AbuseIPDB is unreachable the same change is still driven to Closed with the raw (un-enriched) IP list attached. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity requires: Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the workspace, Key Vault Secrets User on the Key Vault, and Storage Blob Data Contributor on the blocklist storage account.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
Storage account hosting the blocklist with $web/index.html present (static website enabled).
AzureSentinel and KeyVault API connections (this template creates them if absent).

OMS-owned AbuseIPDB API connection 'abuseipdb-connection-AbuseIPDB-EnrichIncidentByIPInfo' in resource group LSY_WEUR_ITCS_PRD_OMS_RG_001 already authorised; this template does not create or modify it.
metadata.author: TI handling automation

metadata.description: Name for the Logic App and its API connections. Must match the deployed Logic App ('TI-handler') so a default deploy updates the existing playbook in place rather than spinning up a second parallel one with a fresh managed identity.
Azure region for the Logic App. Must match the existing Sentinel/Key Vault region.
Name of the Key Vault holding the Trackspace service account password. Defaulted to the production vault so the deploy never falls through to an interactive prompt.
Trackspace base URL.
Trackspace service account username (Basic auth).
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Project the Technical change is raised in.
Issue type id for 'Technical change' in OPSLSY.
First walk target status after create. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of each transition's target status name.
Second walk target; the ticket sits here while enrichment + blocklist write run.
Third walk target; resolution + actual start/finish are set on this transition.
Final walk target. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of the transition's target status name; statusCategory 'done' is also accepted.
Trackspace user name set as change Owner (customfield_12707).
Trackspace user name set as Assignee.
Trackspace user name set as Change manager (customfield_22914) - Emil Pollak.
Elements Connect object key for the Affected item (customfield_24305), required to pass the Start implementation transition. Written as [{ "key": "<this>" }].
Storage account hosting the blocklist.
Inclusive lower bound for AbuseIPDB totalReports. IPs with fewer reports are dropped.
ISP names (lower-case) whose IPs are always dropped, even if totalReports >= MinReports.

fields.summary: [TEST] - Block malicious/suspicious IPs reported by Microsoft Sentinel Threat Intelligence - @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['dateStamp']}
fields.description:
*GOAL:* Block suspicious/malicious IPs maked by Microsoft Sentinel Threat Intelligence
*Root-cause:* Several Sentinel alert created indicating there are communication with these IPs.
*Time frame:* in optimal case approximately 5 minutes
*Accurate start time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['plannedStart']}
*Accurate finish time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['plannedEnd']}
*Affected Service:* Palo Alto Fws
*Impact:* Not expected.
*Tested:* OPSLSY-37786
*Communicate and contact:* LSYH, BUD NETOPS and LSYH, BUD SECOPS
*Rollback:* Remove IP(s) that cause problem from External dynamic deny rule named - Sentinel_Threat_Intelligence_IPs

Blocked IPs can be found in the attachment.
